p1: Failure to vote on a constitutional amendment
p1: will have the same effect as voting no on the
p1: amendment.
p1: To vote for a proposed constitutional
p1: amendment, fill in the oval next to the word
p1: "Yes" on that question. To vote against a
p1: proposed constitutional amendment, fill in the
p1: oval next to the word "No" on that question.

p1: to increase the funding going to all school
p1: districts from the permanent school fund, which
p1: is a fund that supports school districts without
p1: raising individual income or property taxes,
p1: effective July 1, 2027?
